about: Deterministic AI-tell catalog used by the linter. Each tell lists the sources it came from. 'read' says whether the page was read in full or only seen through a search result summary. Weights are hand-set: 2 = strong structural tell, 1 = clear tell, 0.5 = weak tell that is common in human writing too. No tell is proof of AI authorship.

tells.label: Not just X, but Y
tells.hint: Say the point directly instead of setting up a contrast.

tells.label: It's not X, it's Y
tells.hint: Lead with what it is. Drop the 'not X' setup.
tells.pattern: \b(?:it|this|that|these|they|we|you|he|she)(?:'s not|’s not| is not| isn't| isn’t| are not| aren't| aren’t|'re not|’re not| was not| wasn't| wasn’t)\b[^.!?\n]{1,60}?[,;:.]\s*(?:but\s+)?(?:it|this|that|they|we|you|he|she)(?:'s|’s| is| are|'re|’re| was)\b

tells.label: Isn't about X, it's about Y
tells.hint: State what it is about.

tells.label: Less about X, more about Y
tells.hint: Say what it is about.

tells.label: Not X. Not Y. Just Z.
tells.hint: Remove the staged negations.

tells.label: The real question isn't
tells.hint: Ask or answer the question itself.

tells.label: Group of three
tells.hint: Keep the items that carry meaning. Use two, or one, when the third is filler.

tells.label: Three punchy fragments in a row
tells.hint: Join the fragments into a sentence.

tells.label: Stock AI word
tells.hint: Use the plain word you would say out loud.

tells.label: Overused AI word
tells.hint: Fine once in a while. Swap it for a plainer word if it is doing no work.

tells.label: Significance adverb
tells.hint: Cut the adverb and let the plain statement stand.

tells.label: Formal connector
tells.hint: Drop the connector or use 'and', 'but', 'so', or nothing.

tells.label: Filler transition
tells.hint: Delete it and start with the point.
tells.pattern: \b(?:it is important to (?:note|remember|recognize)|it'?s important to (?:note|remember|recognize)|it is worth (?:noting|mentioning)|it'?s worth (?:noting|mentioning)|needless to say|it goes without saying|as (?:previously|mentioned) (?:mentioned|earlier|above)|with that (?:being )?said|that being said|having said that|in light of this|in this regard|it should be noted)\b

tells.label: Stated lesson
tells.hint: Trust the reader. Cut the moral or fold it into the facts.
tells.pattern: \b(?:the (?:real |key |biggest |main )?(?:lesson|takeaway|moral)(?: here)? is|(?:this|that|it) (?:experience )?(?:taught|teaches|showed|reminded|reminds) me (?:that|how|the)|I (?:learned|realized|came to understand) that|what (?:really |truly )?matters (?:most )?is|at the end of the day|it'?s (?:clear|evident|undeniable) that)\b

tells.label: Tidy summary
tells.hint: End on the last real point instead of summarizing.
tells.pattern: \b(?:in conclusion|in summary|to sum (?:it )?up|to summarize|in short|simply put|put simply|in essence|in a nutshell|all in all)\b

tells.label: Significance tail (-ing)
tells.hint: End the sentence at the fact. Cut the clause that explains why it matters.
tells.pattern: ,\s(?:highlighting|underscoring|emphasizing|showcasing|reflecting|symbolizing|ensuring|fostering|cultivating|demonstrating|illustrating|reinforcing|solidifying|cementing|paving the way|setting the stage|marking a|contributing to)\b

tells.label: This highlights the importance
tells.hint: Say what follows from it, concretely, or cut it.

tells.label: Announce-then-reveal
tells.hint: Skip the drumroll. Say the thing.

tells.label: Stock opening
tells.hint: Open with the specific point, not a scene-setter.
tells.pattern: \b(?:in today'?s (?:[\w-]+ ){0,3}?(?:world|age|era|landscape|economy|marketplace|market|environment|climate|society)\b|in (?:an|this|the) (?:era|age) (?:of|where)|in the (?:ever-evolving|rapidly evolving|ever-changing) (?:world|landscape|field) of|have you ever wondered|imagine a world|picture this|when it comes to|let'?s (?:dive|delve|explore|break (?:it|this) down|take a (?:closer )?look|unpack)|whether you'?re (?:a|an) [^,.]{1,40},? or (?:a|an)\b)

tells.label: Stock ending
tells.hint: Stop when the content stops.
tells.pattern: \b(?:I hope this helps|feel free to (?:reach out|ask|contact)|let me know if you (?:have|need)|happy to help|only time will tell|the possibilities are endless|the future (?:is|looks) bright|the sky'?s the limit|stay tuned|great question|as of my (?:last|latest) (?:update|knowledge))\b

tells.label: Em or en dash
tells.hint: Use a comma, a period, parentheses, or a colon.

tells.label: False 'from X to Y' range
tells.hint: List the real items, or name the one that matters.

tells.label: Bold inside prose
tells.hint: Let sentences carry emphasis.

tells.label: Bold-first bullet
tells.hint: Write the list as sentences, or keep plain bullets.

tells.label: Heading in short prose
tells.hint: Short pieces rarely need headings.

tells.label: Emoji or arrow decoration
tells.hint: Use words.

tells.label: Uniform sentence length
tells.hint: Mix short sentences with longer ones.

tells.label: Repeated sentence openers
tells.hint: Start sentences in different ways.

tells.label: Uniform paragraph length
tells.hint: Let paragraphs be as long as their content.

tells.label: Hedge density
tells.hint: Commit where you are sure. Hedge only real uncertainty.

tells.label: Stacked hedge
tells.hint: One hedge is enough.

tells.label: Grandiose claim
tells.hint: Say what actually changed, with a detail, or tone it down.

tells.label: 'Serves as' instead of 'is'
tells.hint: Use 'is'.

tells.label: Vague attribution
tells.hint: Name the source, or state it as your own view.

tells.label: Despite these challenges
tells.hint: Say what the problem is and what was done about it.

tells.label: Think of it as
tells.hint: Explain it directly.

tells.label: Diverse array of
tells.hint: Name the items, or say 'many'.

tells.label: Navigate the complexities
tells.hint: Say what the person actually does.
